meta.title: toki pona bottom up dictionary
notes: Unofficial project. Not by Sonja Lang and not 'Official Toki Pona'.
Formally checked (Forth order, no cycles, all 137 words covered); not semantically verified.
English and Spanish glosses are AI-assisted translations of the German project glosses and need review.
Tokens in 'def' are resolved reading ids (lemma@n) or punctuation. Expansions are not included.

ala@1.prime: NOT; DON'T WANT (wile ala); SOME (ale ala)

gloss.es: abajo, la zona debajo de algo
suceder, venir, llegar a ser; próximo

lili@1.prime: LITTLE/FEW; SMALL; A SHORT TIME (tenpo lili)

gloss.es: arriba, la zona encima de algo

suli@1.prime: BIG; A LONG TIME (tenpo suli); VERY

gloss.es: por, a causa de; de, desde

tenpo@1.prime: WHEN/TIME; MOMENT; NOW; FOR SOME TIME
